claim_boundary: Frozen development-only evaluation of the official MINT checkpoint and Bernett PPI head on authenticated AsEP and SAbDab2 cognate/matched-decoy panels. Decoys are ranking controls, not measured biological noninteractions. This protocol does not authorize contact claims, calibration claims, test access, or SOTA claims.

length_policy.aggregation: arithmetic mean of raw PPI logits over the Cartesian product of endpoint windows; sigmoid is applied only after aggregation
length_policy.rationale: The official MINT examples use a 512-token per-chain crop including CLS/EOS. Start, center, and end windows remove random-crop variance while preserving coverage for the ten development complexes above the 1024-token two-chain budget.

metrics.candidate_scores: official Bernett PPI raw logit with fixed antibody-then-antigen chain order

duplicate_policy.primary: collapse exact candidate endpoint sequence duplicates before ranking
duplicate_policy.secondary: retain all 31 frozen candidate instances and use average tie rank

metrics.weighting: primary macro average over unique canonical exact cognate pairs after averaging duplicate structure instances

model.head_training_domain: Bernett general PPI benchmark; no antibody-specific calibration is assumed
model.label: MINT ESM2-650M backbone plus multimer branch; 813.37M unique parameters
